# Al-Man Raffli Saputra — Raffli Dev

> Official portfolio of Al-Man Raffli Saputra (also known as Raffli and Darren0099), a Diploma III Computer Engineering graduate of Politeknik Negeri Sriwijaya, Indonesia.

This website documents Raffli's professional background, technical projects, graphic design portfolio, skills, certificates, and contact information. Content is primarily in Indonesian, with English-language options.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://rafflidev.my.id/): Introduction, professional roles, experience, featured projects, certificates and contact links.
- [About Me](https://rafflidev.my.id/aboutme): Education, experience and personal professional profile.
- [All Projects](https://rafflidev.my.id/projects): Website development, analytics, IoT and digital portfolio projects.
- [Graphic Design](https://rafflidev.my.id/graphic-design): Branding, visual communication and social-media design archive.
- [Curriculum Vitae](https://rafflidev.my.id/cv): Interactive curriculum vitae and resume.

## Selected projects

- [Mobius](https://rafflidev.my.id/projects/mobius): Windows desktop assistant and local file conversion studio.
- [KleinData](https://rafflidev.my.id/projects/kleindata): Data exploration and analysis from CSV and spreadsheet inputs.
- [Palembang Go Vacation](https://rafflidev.my.id/projects/palembang-go-vacation): Travel-focused website.
